author: Giorgio Mendoza
description: LILYGO has listed two development platforms, the T-Display CM0 and T-CAN485 C5, covering Linux-based touchscreen applications and industrial IoT connectivity. The former uses a quad-core Arm processor with a 4.1-inch AMOLED display, while the latter integrates Espressif’s ESP32-C5 with Wi-Fi 6, CAN bus, RS-485, and Ethernet. title: LILYGO CM0 terminal and ESP32-C5 board bridge Linux and industrial IoT

author: Giorgio Mendoza
description: The Jetway MTX-RYZ1 is an upcoming Mini-ITX industrial motherboard powered by the AMD Ryzen 7 PRO 8845HS processor. The board supports up to 96GB of DDR5 memory and combines dual 2.5GbE networking, PCIe Gen4 expansion, and four display outputs with industrial connectivity options.
